verified_contracts: Complete generated text and durable event dependencies precede first TTS chunk; awaiting_playback is not assistant_played
One playback token and contiguous sentence offsets bind to the complete ordered native 24kHz mono PCM16 SHA and sample count
Only complete player ACK of the exact final receipt commits assistant_played; queued network completion alone does not
Independent Store forget/correct/clear and profile revoke block first or later chunks without relying on controller cancellation Event
Second TTS failure and cancellation after first chunk never mark partial text heard; Jobs clears queued packets and publishes failure
Ordinary-stream durable guards run before each packet publication and after backpressure waits; local FSM generating path is unchanged
Default nonstream path, original model request owner and single original deadline remain supported

review_finding_resolved.initial_bug: A same-sentence sink could enqueue further packets after independent durable invalidation; final bind rejection cannot undo PCM already consumed
review_finding_resolved.resolution: Request-local ordinary-stream admission_guard in Jobs._put, SQL outside jobs condition, recheck after every wait, append only while current

limitations: Checks are bounded snapshots, not future authorization leases; already emitted or physically played PCM cannot be retracted
No actual speakers, model host, device, network or private production database was used
No real first-audio latency, listening quality or hardware playback acceptance is claimed
